sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent reconstructed center tile, ordered inward samples, sample multiplicities, and uniquely modal inward color.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the 3x3 macro-tile source, reconstruct the missing center tile from all eight inward-facing boundaries, and count the eight inward anchor colors.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Retain the source 3x3 arrangement and copy outward either every surrounding tile or exactly those whose inward sample has the modal color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Under modal_inward, the outward renderer cannot select source tiles until the missing-center analysis has measured and compared the eight input-dependent inward samples.

parametric_work.summary: Native all|modal_inward family with 2–6 demonstrations, four private queries, protected Racket labels, finite-rival audit, public projection, authoring preflight, and source-bound causal replay.

target.summary: Built the general missing-center tile reconstruction and outward-projection rule plus a modal-inward selection branch.
